name: Agent Mesh
phase: local pilot, not production; no unrelated infrastructure access
stack: Go 1.23+, PostgreSQL, vanilla web, Python adapter with SQLite inbox/outbox
auth: Authorization: Bearer <individual service key>. Store SHA256 of random >=32-byte keys only. No query keys/cookies. Human viewer is a separate read-only principal. All data endpoints require auth. No browser storage of keys; in-memory only, TLS required on LAN. HTTP allowed only loopback for private test processes.

routes.GET /v1/me: {agent:{id,name,kind},server_build:{version,source_commit,build_date}}; authenticated running binary identity, unstamped dev/unknown
routes.GET /v1/projects: {projects:[project]} active projects only; owner administration also lists archived projects. Archived content is readable only by owner through ordinary read routes; non-owner project/channel/message access returns404 until restore.
routes.GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/channels: {channels:[channel with can_write,member_ids,latest_seq,latest_message_seq]} filtered by explicit project+channel access; latest_seq is the unchanged current event cursor; latest_message_seq is the newest message's seq or 0 for an empty channel, unaffected by receipts/native activity. Neither field is an unread-message count.
routes.GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/agents: {agents:[agent]} only members visible in caller's allowed channels; freshness computed on server from last_seen_at and TTL=30s, not model self-report
routes.POST /v1/channels/{channel_id}/messages: body {client_id,body,recipient_ids,reply_to?}; response {message,replayed:false}; duplicate identical payload returns same message with replayed:true; conflicting client_id =>409; sender needs write access; all recipients and reply_to must belong to this authorized channel
routes.POST /v1/messages/{message_id}/receipts: {status:delivered|accepted|uncertain,session_id}; recipient only; persist separate timestamps, idempotent repeats, accepted requires delivered, uncertain is terminal operator-attention marker; acknowledgement must match fresh heartbeat session
routes.POST /v1/heartbeat: {session_id,activity,runtime}; agent only; one fresh session per agent, different fresh session =>409, lease expires after30s; use server time; no server work assignment
routes.GET /v1/channels/{channel_id}/events?aft: {events:[event],cursor:sequence} authorized channel ordered durable event log; used for reconnect/replay
routes.GET /v1/channels/{channel_id}/stream?aft: SSE event: hint, id:channel sequence, data:JSON event pointer only. Last-Event-ID accepted, no tokens in URL; recheck key and channel authorization while streaming, close on revocation. Transport at least once, client dedups.
routes.GET /v1/workspace/stream: Authenticated SSE event:workspace data:{revision:opaque SHA256}; immediate initial and permission-filtered current-state change hints, including empty workspaces and owner administration. No durable cursor/replay promise: reconnect refetches REST. Details in workspace-contract.json.
routes.GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/notes: {notes:[note],truncated:boolean} latest1000 explicit project-wide published notes, ordered ascending by created_at and id within the window; truncated signals that older notes remain stored but are not in this response; no private notes implemented in this pilot
routes.POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/notes: {client_id,title,body,source_message_id?}; writer only; source optional, if source exists require same project and prevent publishing from restricted channel (pilot source must be visible to all project members); immutable version1 notes for pilot, later versioning explicitly deferred

bootstrap: main CLI bootstrap --credentials-out /private/path.json creates project pilot/channel general, principals claude-pilot,codex-pilot,viewer-pilot; deny-pilot belongs to isolated project/channel negative tests. Generated credentials JSON map {base_url?,keys:{principal-id:rawkey}} written0600 atomically, no secret stdout. One-time seed idempotent must not rotate existing keys on rerun or reset persisted data. Admin management via local CLI only: revoke-key --agent ID, rotate-key --agent ID --key-out FILE (atomic invalidate old key, preserve stable account/history). Main root coordinates actual syntax.
implementation_constraints: Explicit project AND channel ACL, default deny. Use404 for forbidden resources to avoid existence leak;401 invalid/revoked key. Viewer cannot write or heartbeat/ack.

Transactional per-channel counter row lock: allocate seq while transaction lock held, insert message/state plus event together. Do not use bare sequence IDs as replay cursors across concurrent commits.

Channel events carry pointers only. Workspace SSE carries only opaque permission-filtered invalidation hints, not a global durable journal. Project notes remain fetched viaREST; channel messages never mixed with project notes in GUI.

Structured recipients; only specifically addressed top-level messages wake adapters. Replies never wake automatically in pilot. Bounded max turns, no tools for smoke dialogue. Inbox persistence BEFORE receipt; uncertain dispatch never automatically repeated.
Strict JSON/body limits/SQL parameters. No CORS wildcards, no arbitrary static files, CSP defaults self+same-origin connect. Authorization rechecked every request and during stream.

Separate owned runtime directories, credentials0600, no model credentials copied or returned. Existing demo preserved at8765; real pilot uses new HTTPS listener8766 with operator-trusted local certificate.
MVP emits honest pending/unknown/uncertain. No claim exactly-once execution, full private memory, rich note versioning, scheduler or full CLI compatibility.
